en: A black-and-white postcard view of a religious complex at the foot of a wooded hillside. In the foreground is a large multi‑story building with arched windows and a small central bell tower topped with a cross, likely a monastery or religious hospital. To the left stands a church with a tower and onion-shaped dome. Scattered houses sit higher on the slope, surrounded by trees and orchards. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
